name: Pad Mixer
changelog: 0.3.0: a meter beside each fader -- the pad's peak as the engine renders it, after the fader, -48..0 dBFS, falling ~60 dB/s, yellow from -6 dB, red for half a second after a clip; the engine measures only while the app is open (IPadMix::setMetering/takePeaks, core 2.22). Requires core 2.22.

0.2.2: a root deleted before the app's teardown is handled (gui 2.0 calls destroy with none); builds on core 1.70+/gui 1.28+ and on core/gui 2.x (>=1.70.0,<3.0.0 and >=1.28.0,<3.0.0) for the merge window
0.2.1: a fader the encoder is clicked into keeps the focus while pads are played -- a hit no longer moves it to that pad's fader until the encoder lets go
0.2.0: pad levels through IPadMix (core 1.21) instead of the Sampler's platform callbacks; faders follow a kit swapped while open; a sequenced hit is told apart with PadManager::pressSource()
0.1.0: Generated from the CrossPad app template
